text:
Lina (CS): heads-up — customer ACME-5682 says they were charged twice for a reserved Dedicated pool this billing cycle. asked for evidence attachment; shared invoice/charge ids below.

Lina (CS): acct: ACME-5682
Invoice: INV-2026-03-07-345
Stripe charges: ch_1MPUX7a2bXXXXXXX and ch_1MPTX6z9cYYYYYYY
Customer claims both settled, asks for reversal of the duplicate. Screenshot of bank ledger attached.

Jesse (Finance): thanks Lina. can we confirm which one corresponds to the reserved capacity vs. usage overage? also need the payment method last4 and whether either was disputed upstream.

Lina (CS): last4: 4242, both show as "succeeded" in stripe UI. customer email says they were billed twice at 03:12 and 03:15 UTC.

Maya (BillingOps): putting account on temporary billing hold pending review. @Jesse adding to FS-Review queue.

billing-bot: webhook received: payment_intent.succeeded for pi_1MrExampleA at 2026-03-07T03:12:34Z (ch_1MPUX7...)

Alejandro (Eng): I pulled the provisioning logs — there was a retry during quota enforcement that created a second reservation order at 03:14 due to a transient timeout talking to our allocation service. looks like the reservation succeeded twice. logs: ``service=allocator request_id=alloc-9f3a status=200 retry=1``

Jesse (Finance): ok that explains a duplicate reservation being billed. Proposal: refund the later charge (ch_1MPTX6z9cYYYYYYY) and mark as credit on next invoice OR issue immediate refund depending on customer preference. @Maya what's our refund workflow here?

Maya (BillingOps): We can refund immediately via Stripe once Engineering confirms which one is the duplicate. Need a short rationale for the refund (internal memo) and a note tying it to INV-2026-03-07-345. I'll also create a chargeback evidence packet in case the customer disputes on their bank side.

Jesse (Finance): please include: incident id, allocator retry log lines, and the two charge IDs. I'll approve the refund once the packet is attached.

Alejandro (Eng): adding allocator trace and correlation id: alloc-9f3a -> txn=tx-77b9. Copy of log snippet below:
```
2026-03-07T03:12:31Z alloc-9f3a request start
2026-03-07T03:12:34Z alloc-9f3a success reserved id=resv_abc123
2026-03-07T03:14:02Z alloc-9f3a retry failed due to timeout, retried
2026-03-07T03:14:05Z alloc-9f3a success reserved id=resv_def456
```
Those two reserves map to charge ch_1MPUX7... -> resv_abc123 and ch_1MPTX6... -> resv_def456. Recommend refunding resv_def456.

Maya (BillingOps): got it. creating refund now and attaching the eng memo and logs to the ticket. Will mark as "refund-processor: manual" and tag invoice INV-2026-03-07-345.

Jesse (Finance): approved. go ahead with full refund for ch_1MPTX6z9cYYYYYYY and apply a one-time credit to the customer for any inconvenience. please CC Lina on the dispatch.

Lina (CS): will update customer: refund issued and credit applied. thanks team. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: refund created: rf_1MRefundXYZ for charge ch_1MPTX6z9cYYYYYYY (status: pending)

Maya (BillingOps): refund succeeded: rf_1MRefundXYZ (status: succeeded). updated invoice and closed FS-Review ticket.

Lina (CS): customer confirmed refund receipt and appreciated the quick turnaround. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
